items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nancy Reagan was the one, I think, who made a decision that for the state dinner, they would invite you to go.

ctx.x: Dave, I want to return to the theme of you being a real ambassador during your career. You were part of the Reagan-Gorbachev summit, and you contributed to creating some lasting goodwill on that occasion. Could you tell me what your recollections are?

With Gorbachev and Reagan. I had a few things come to mind: a room where Garbechev had just made life a lot easier for poets and musicians or political people that had been sent to Siberia. Sitting next to Iola was a general in the Russian Army. Here these people – I wish I could remember the scientist’s name. Or the wife. He was such an important scientist, but he’d been ostracized.
